title: Health Recoded: Your Guide to Intelligent Healthcare
description: The Breakthrough Medicine Your Doctor Hasn’t Told You About—Yet A veteran was three days from amputation when a single phone call connected him to a procedure that saved his leg. The technology had existed for years. No one on his care team had thought to offer it. In Health Recoded , board-certified regenerative medicine specialist and Stanford Adjunct Clinical Faculty member Annu Navani, MD, maps fifteen breakthrough technologies already rewriting the rules of human health and explains why the gap between what medicine can do and what patients are offered has become one of the defining problems of modern healthcare. Readers will learn : How AI and genomics detect disease years before symptoms appear What regenerative medicine and stem cell therapy can do that surgery cannot How CRISPR gene editing and synthetic biology are correcting disease at its source Why longevity medicine is changing the standard of care for aging How to become a more informed, empowered advocate for your own health Covering genomics, AI, regenerative medicine, surgical robotics, bioelectronic therapy, longevity science, and more, Health Recoded is a practical, authoritative guide for anyone who wants to understand what modern medicine is truly capable of, and how to make sure they receive it.  if(window.mix_csa){window.mix_csa('[cel_widget_id="tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_6"]', '#CardInstanceUIsoOBXmOQiLxgZAzGQ3MA')('mark', 'bb')} if(window.uet){window.uet('bb','tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_6',{wb: 1})} ._tell-amazon-desktop_style_tell_amazon_icon_core_report__Fs1ah{color:#0f1111;color:var(--aok-sfs-color-page-primary-normal-fg,#0f1111);display:inline-block;-webkit-filter:none;filter:none;-webkit-filter:var(--aok-sfs-effect-mode-dark-color-silhouette-white,none);filter:var(--aok-sfs-effect-

title: Daily Health & Longevity Logbook: A simple, structured tracker for habits, biometrics & pr
description: Simple, consistent tracking beats complicated plans. The Daily Health & Longevity Logbook gives you a clean, repeatable system to capture the daily inputs that drive long-term results—without the clutter. Track the essentials Biometrics: weight (AM/PM), height; blood pressure & pulse (AM/PM); glucose (fasting, 2-hr post-meal, evening) Intermittent fasting: last/first calorie (close/open) plus eating and fasting hours Sleep: bedtime, wake-up, total hours, quality (1–5) Movement: steps, exercise type, minutes, RPE (intensity) Breathing/mindfulness: minutes or sessions Notes: space for observations, meds, or goals See the big picture Weekly summary pages help you average metrics, total activity, and spotlight trends—so you can iterate with purpose. Designed for real life Clear typography and ample writing space KDP-friendly 6×9″ trim Available in US units (lb/in, mg/dL) and Metric (kg/cm, mmol/L) editions Evidence-informed prompts to support consistent, comparable entries Whether you’re pursuing weight loss, metabolic health, blood-pressure control, better sleep, or simply more intentional days, this logbook keeps you focused on actions you can repeat. Disclaimer: This book does not provide medical advice and is not a substitute for professional diagnosis or treatment. If you have questions about your health—or are considering changes to medication, diet, exercise, or sleep—consult your own doctor or qualified health professional.
